dist_source: OSM path length (promenade footway, way 240459461)
start_n: Marina promenade near the Anna and MGR memorials, Kamarajar Salai
hours: Open all day; busiest at dawn and after 5 PM
d: The paved promenade beside Kamarajar Salai, running south along the Marina from the memorials to the Lighthouse. Flat and wide, with sea views the whole way; most people simply turn round at either end.
t: Best before 7 AM, when the sea breeze is up and the crowds are thin
notes: Wikipedia gives the whole promenade as about 6 km; this row covers the 2.8 km stretch that OSM maps as one continuous footway. Sources: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Marina_Beach | https://greatruns.com/chennai-marina-beach/

n: Loop Road, Santhome to Foreshore Estate
dist_source: OSM path length (road graph, Lighthouse to Foreshore Estate)
start_n: Loop Road at the Marina Lighthouse
d: The beach-side Loop Road that carries on south from the Lighthouse past the fishing hamlets to Foreshore Estate. A quieter continuation of the Marina, best combined with the promenade for a longer run.
t: Early morning; the road has traffic and fish-market activity later in the day
notes: Judgement call: this is a public road shared with vehicles and the Pattinapakkam fish stalls, not a closed promenade. Distance from the OSM road network.

dist_source: OSM path length (promenade way 1124765729, closed)
start_n: Elliot's Beach promenade near the Velankanni shrine
end_n: Elliot's Beach promenade near the Velankanni shrine
post_run: Cafés and tiffin places on Besant Nagar 2nd Avenue
d: The paved promenade along Elliot's Beach from the Velankanni shrine end to the Karl Schmidt memorial and back. Short, flat and lively, with an outdoor gym and food stalls along the way.
t: Before 7 AM on weekdays; Sunday mornings are crowded
notes: A Sunday car-free morning on Elliot's Beach Road (6 to 9 AM) is reported, but the source is undated; confirm before listing it. Source: https://www.dtnext.in/news/chennai/happy-streets-to-cheer-city-people-on-sundays

d: Runners use the firm sand south from Thiruvanmiyur towards Kottivakkam at low tide. There is no promenade, so the line cannot be drawn from a path.
notes: Hold: no mapped path on the sand, and the usable length depends on the tide. Pin is the OSM beach feature (Nominatim). Distance not stated by any source found.

d: A quieter stretch of sand off ECR at Neelankarai, used by residents for morning runs and walks. No promenade; you run on the beach itself.
notes: Hold: no mapped path on the sand. Pin is Beach Road, Neelankarai (Nominatim). No source gives a distance.

n: Adyar Eco Park (Tholkappia Poonga) walkers’ circuit
start_n: Tholkappia Poonga, main gate (pin at park centre)
end_n: Tholkappia Poonga, main gate (pin at park centre)
hours: Walkers: 6:30 – 8 AM and 4:30 – 6 PM, pass holders only
d: The restored Adyar estuary park, with paths through scrub, wetland and the creek edge. Walking is by pass only, in fixed morning and evening slots.
t: Book a slot online before you go
notes: Hold: OSM has the paths but no clean circuit, and no source states the walking loop length (a test trace gave 3.7 km against a 3.3 km outline, so it is not trustworthy). Access rules: walkers need a pass bought online; ID checked at the main gate; entry and exit only through the main gate. Fees were revised from 1 February 2026 after protests (Mylapore Times); earlier figure was ₹20 a visit. Reopened after renovation in October 2025. Sources: https://crrt.tn.gov.in/walkers-instruction | https://www.mylaporetimes.com/2026/01/tholkappia-poonga-revised-lesser-fees-and-increased-slots-for-walkers-changes-made-after-protests | https://www.mylaporetimes.com/2025/10/renovated-tholkappia-poonga-re-opened-walkers-visitors-and-school-college-groups-can-visit

dist_source: OSM path length (footway circuit traced round the park)
hours: Early morning to about 9:30 AM, and evenings (reported)
d: A narrow strip of native trees beside the Adyar river at Kotturpuram, with one path running its length. Shaded and quiet; walkers go up and back.
notes: Hours vary between listings (one says 5:30 to 10 AM; reviews mention evening opening to 6:30 or 7 PM). Source: https://yappe.in/tamil-nadu/chennai/kotturpuram-tree-park/20407

dist_source: OSM path length (footway circuit traced round the park)
start_n: Nageswara Rao Park, Luz Church Road
end_n: Nageswara Rao Park, Luz Church Road
hours: Morning walkers until 10 AM (2021 change); evenings
d: Mylapore's best-known walking park, a shaded circuit under old trees off Luz Church Road. Regulars do laps of the perimeter path in the early morning.
notes: Morning closing time was moved to 10 AM in 2021 (Mylapore Times); confirm current hours. Source: https://www.mylaporetimes.com/2021/08/nageswara-rao-park-to-be-kept-open-till-10-a-m-so-seniors-can-go-on-walks-leisurely/

dist_source: OSM path length (footway circuit traced round the park)
d: A small neighbourhood park in T. Nagar with a walking path round its edge. Useful for short laps away from the shopping streets.
notes: Short loop; laps needed for distance. No current hours found.

dist_source: OSM park outline perimeter (inner track not mapped)
d: The old park at the head of Pondy Bazaar, used by T. Nagar residents for morning laps. Small, so expect to go round several times.
notes: Distance is the park outline from OSM; the inner path is only partly mapped. Metro works have affected the area; confirm the park is fully open.

dist_source: OSM path length (footway circuit traced round the park)
d: The botanical garden on Cathedral Road, with paved paths through themed plantings and a small water feature. A gentle walk rather than a run.
notes: Ticketed garden; entry fees were raised in 2024 (reported) and it hosts the January flower show, when walking is crowded. Confirm walkers’ hours. Source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Semmozhi_Poonga

dist_source: OSM park outline perimeter (inner track not mapped)
d: Anna Nagar's large park round the viewing tower, with a walking track and an outdoor gym. The neighbourhood's main spot for morning walks and jogs.
notes: Distance is the park outline from OSM; the track inside is not mapped. A Rs 30 crore makeover was announced (DT Next), so parts may be closed for works. Sources: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Anna_Nagar_Tower_Park | https://www.dtnext.in/amp/story/news/chennai/anna-nagar-tower-park-set-for-a-vibrant-makeover-with-rs-30-crore-budget-825289 | https://greatruns.com/chennai-anna-nagar-area/

n: Anna Nagar 2nd Avenue Happy Streets stretch
dist_source: OSM path length (road graph, Blue Star to Nalli junction)
hours: Sunday 6 – 9 AM when Happy Streets runs
d: The stretch of 2nd Avenue closed to traffic on Happy Streets Sundays, when it fills with walkers, cyclists and games. The city's first Happy Streets ran here.
notes: Judgement call: Happy Streets runs in rounds of five Sundays per area, not permanently; the Blue Star to Nalli junction closure is from an undated report. Check Greater Chennai Corporation announcements. Sources: https://www.dtnext.in/news/chennai/happy-streets-to-cheer-city-people-on-sundays | https://yocee.in/happy-streets-make-people-happy/

dist_source: OSM path length (lakeside footways traced round Chetpet Lake)
hours: Walkers about 5 – 8:30 AM and 5 – 8 PM; closed Tuesday (reported)
d: A paved walkway round the restored Chetpet lake, with boating and an aquarium in the same park. One of the few proper lake loops in central Chennai.
notes: Listings give a loop of about 1.2 to 2 km; OSM trace is 1.3 km. Entry fee and walkers’ monthly passes reported (2016 to 2018 figures). Sources: https://venkatarangan.com/blog/2018/06/unbelievable-this-eco-park-and-boathouse-is-in-chennai-city/ | https://www.dtnext.in/news/chennai/chetpet-ecopark-opened-for-summer-fun

dist_source: OSM path length (Sivan Park walking path)
d: A popular neighbourhood park in K.K. Nagar with a marked walking path round the edge. Busy with walkers at dawn and dusk.
notes: OSM names the circuit "Sivan Park Walking path". No current hours found.

n: Thiru Vi Ka Park loop, Shenoy Nagar
dist_source: OSM park outline perimeter (inner track not mapped)
start_n: Thiru Vi Ka Park, Shenoy Nagar
end_n: Thiru Vi Ka Park, Shenoy Nagar
d: The large park above Shenoy Nagar metro station, rebuilt after the metro works, with paths round its edge. A good loop for Kilpauk, Aminjikarai and Shenoy Nagar residents.
notes: Distance is the park outline; OSM maps many inner paths but no single circuit. Confirm current opening hours.

dist_source: OSM path length (footway circuit traced round the park)
d: A pond-side park in Mogappair with a walking path round the water. Short laps in a quiet residential pocket.
notes: Small loop; no current hours found.

dist_source: OSM park outline perimeter (inner track not mapped)
d: The horticulture department garden at Madhavaram, with paths through lawns and plant collections. A rare green space for north Chennai walkers.
notes: Distance is the garden outline from OSM; inner paths only partly mapped. Entry fee and walkers’ hours not confirmed.

dist_source: OSM path length (footway circuit traced round the park)
d: A small T. Nagar park with a walking path round its edge, used by nearby residents for short morning laps.
notes: Very short loop; laps needed for distance. No current hours found.

dist_source: OSM path length (footway circuit traced round the park)
d: The old Napier Park by the Cooum near Chintadripet, with a mapped path circuit. One of the few green spaces in the Egmore and Chintadripet area.
notes: Judgement call: no current source confirms walkers’ hours or that it is open after recent works; keep only if confirmed.

d: Paths into the Pallikaranai marsh, the city’s last large wetland, used for guided birding walks. Not a running route; go with an organised walk.
t: Guided walks, usually 6:30 to 8:30 AM or 4:30 to 6 PM
notes: Hold: no public walkway mapped in OSM; walks are run as events by CAG, Care Earth Trust and the Madras Naturalists’ Society. One source describes T-shaped paths totalling about 1 km. Pin is the OSM road point on Radial Road beside the marsh, not a gate. Sources: https://www.cag.org.in/events/public-event-pallikaranai-wetland-walk | https://themadrasday.in/nature-walk-pallikaranai-marsh-aug-24-2014

d: Velachery lake is being restored under the CMDA lake programme, with a walkway planned along the western bank. Only short lakeside paths exist today.
notes: Hold: OSM maps only a 300 m lakeside footway; the planned 680 m western promenade is in the CMDA project report, not confirmed as built. Source: https://dredgewire.com/lake-rejuvenation-project-of-cmda-takes-shape-dpr-in-place-for-7-of-10-lakes-in-chennai

dist_source: OSM path length (lake walkway, ways 837321911 and 876008346)
d: A walkway right round the restored Madipakkam lake, revived by residents and Smart City funds. Good birdlife, and hundreds of walkers each morning.
notes: Sources: https://citizenmatters.in/community-led-transformation-of-madipakkam-lake/ | https://cscl.co.in/restoration-of-water-bodies/madipakkam-karthikeyapuram-lake

d: Perumbakkam lake is on the CMDA revitalisation list, with a lakefront and bird interpretation point planned. No continuous walkway is mapped yet.
notes: Hold: no continuous walkway in OSM; a 2 km walking track in one PWD report may refer to Vengaivasal lake instead. Source: https://dredgewire.com/lake-rejuvenation-project-of-cmda-takes-shape-dpr-in-place-for-7-of-10-lakes-in-chennai

d: The bund of Retteri lake by GNT Road, where a walkers’ path was laid in an earlier renovation and a new bund walkway is part of the current restoration.
notes: Hold: OSM has bund roads but no walkway; restoration (Rs 43 crore, WRD) was under way in 2024. Residents have raised safety concerns about the path after dark. Sources: https://citizenmatters.in/retteri-lake-chennai-restoration-sewage-encroachments-wrd-madhavaram/ | https://www.thenewsminute.com/tamil-nadu/chennais-retteri-lake-is-getting-a-new-look-but-residents-say-old-problems-remain

dist_source: OSM path length (bund road way 384430391, doubled)
d: The eastern bund of Ambattur lake, where the Water Resources Department has built an eco-park and walkway. A short out-and-back by the water.
notes: Judgement call: OSM maps the bund as an unnamed road (545 m), not as a walkway, so the full walkway may be longer. Source: https://www.dtnext.in/amp/story/news/chennai/ambattur-ecopark-ready-but-waits-for-shutdown-to-end Turnaround: north end of the mapped bund road; the line runs out and back on the same path.

d: Porur lake is on the CMDA lakefront programme, with a walkway among the planned works. No walkway is mapped yet.
notes: Hold: no walkway in OSM, and the lakefront upgrade is a plan. Porur is also a drinking-water source, so bund access may be restricted. Source: https://dredgewire.com/lake-rejuvenation-project-of-cmda-takes-shape-dpr-in-place-for-7-of-10-lakes-in-chennai

dist_source: OSM path length (walkway way 1052435255, doubled)
d: The renovated walkway along Chitlapakkam lake, saved by a long residents’ campaign. Around 2,000 people use it on weekdays.
notes: Toilets built beside the walkway were still shut a year after construction (DT Next). Sources: https://www.dtnext.in/news/chennai/chennai-citizen-connect-a-year-after-construction-new-toilets-at-chitlapakkam-lake-remain-shut-816135 | https://citizenmatters.in/chennai-rwa-chitlapakkam-ngo-tn-government-bund-preservation/ Turnaround: south end of the walkway; the line runs out and back on the same path.

n: Paruthipattu Eco Park lake loop, Avadi
dist_source: OSM path length (traced round Paruthipattu lake); sources state about 3 km
d: A walking track round Paruthipattu lake at Avadi, built as part of the eco-park. The main lake loop for Avadi and Pattabiram.
notes: Reports give a 3 km walking track round the lake; the OSM trace is 2.9 km. A 2019 report said sewage inflow was driving visitors away; check current condition. Sources: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Paruthipattu_Lake | https://www.dtnext.in/news/chennai/paruthipattu-lake-ecopark-to-be-ready-this-week | https://www.dtnext.in/city/2019/10/14/heavy-sewage-flow-drives-people-away-from-paruthipattu-eco-park-in-avadi-

dist_source: OSM path length (way 1021008225 "Keelkatalai Lake Promenade", doubled)
d: A short lakeside promenade along Keelkattalai lake, mapped in OSM as its own path. Handy for residents of Keelkattalai and Madipakkam.
notes: No news source found describing the promenade; existence from OSM only. Confirm it is open and maintained. Turnaround: north end of the promenade; the line runs out and back on the same path.

dist_source: OSM path length (bund path way 1066030661, doubled)
d: The bund path along Madambakkam lake, restored with community help. An unpaved, quiet walk with water birds on one side.
notes: Source on the restoration: https://citizenmatters.in/chennai-lake-restoration-madambakkam-alleri-vandalur-koladi-efi-18725 Turnaround: north-east end of the bund path; the line runs out and back on the same path.

dist_source: OSM path length (Boat Club Road way 23135527, doubled)
d: A wide, tree-lined residential avenue in R.A. Puram with light traffic early in the morning. Runners repeat it or join it to the neighbouring avenues.
notes: Judgement call: a public road, not a closed track; no published source names it as a running route. Kept because it is a shaded residential avenue next to Adyar Eco Park. Turnaround: north end of Boat Club Road; the line runs out and back on the same path.

dist_source: OSRM road distance over OSM (router.project-osrm.org)
d: The classic Chennai weekend ride down East Coast Road from Thiruvanmiyur, past Neelankarai, Akkarai and Uthandi to the Muttukadu backwaters. Flat, with sea glimpses.
t: Leave before 6 AM; traffic builds fast after 7 AM
notes: Safety: ECR is a busy highway with fast traffic; ride early and in a group. In 2022 police reserved the Kottivakkam to Muttukadu stretch for cyclists 5 to 7 AM on weekends; not confirmed as still running. Sources: https://webjosh.com/article/public-can-utilise-ecr-cycling-track-on-weekends-1643983870-8713 | https://silverkris.singaporeair.com/cycling-chennai/

n: ECR ride: Neelankarai to Uthandi toll
dist_source: OSRM road distance over OSM (router.project-osrm.org), doubled
d: A shorter ECR out-and-back from Neelankarai to the Uthandi toll and back, popular for early weekday spins.
notes: Safety: highway traffic; front and rear lights needed before sunrise. Source for ECR as the city’s main ride: https://silverkris.singaporeair.com/cycling-chennai/ Turnaround: Uthandi; the line runs out and back on the same path.

n: Madhya Kailash to Muttukadu and back
dist_source: OSRM road distance over OSM (router.project-osrm.org), doubled; SilverKris quotes 60 km
d: The long weekend "highway ride" from Madhya Kailash via Thiruvanmiyur down ECR to Muttukadu and back. Around 50 km, flat, best ridden in a group.
notes: Distance conflict: SilverKris gives 60 km; the OSM road distance for the direct route is 49 km, so the 60 km figure probably includes a detour. Safety: busy highway after 7 AM. Source: https://silverkris.singaporeair.com/cycling-chennai/ Turnaround: Muttukadu Boat House; the line runs out and back on the same path.

n: Anna University to Marina beach ride
dist_source: OSRM road distance over OSM (router.project-osrm.org), doubled; SilverKris quotes 22.4 km
d: A city "beach ride" from Anna University via Adyar and Santhome up the Marina to Napier Bridge and back, past the old Presidency buildings.
notes: SilverKris gives 22.4 km for the round trip; the OSM road route is 24.9 km. Safety: city traffic outside early morning. Source: https://silverkris.singaporeair.com/cycling-chennai/ Turnaround: Napier Bridge; the line runs out and back on the same path.

n: Madhya Kailash to Pallikaranai marsh ride
dist_source: OSRM road distance over OSM (router.project-osrm.org), doubled; SilverKris quotes 21 km
d: The "nature ride" down OMR to Thoraipakkam and along the Radial Road beside Pallikaranai marsh, where migratory birds gather in winter, then back.
t: Early morning, November to March for birds
notes: Safety: OMR and the Radial Road carry heavy IT-corridor traffic from 8 AM. Source: https://silverkris.singaporeair.com/cycling-chennai/ Turnaround: Radial Road beside Pallikaranai marsh; the line runs out and back on the same path.

dist_source: OSRM road distance over OSM (router.project-osrm.org)
d: A loop from Anna Nagar Roundtana out along 2nd Avenue past Tower Park and back by 3rd Avenue, on the wide planned avenues of Anna Nagar.
t: Before 7 AM, or on Happy Streets Sundays
notes: Judgement call: the loop is assembled from the named avenues (OSM), not from a published club route. Source on Anna Nagar cycling and the Tower Park end: https://greatruns.com/chennai-anna-nagar-area/

dist_source: OSRM road distance over OSM (router.project-osrm.org)
d: A short loop from Elliot's Beach through Besant Nagar to Kalakshetra Road, up to Adyar signal and back by Lattice Bridge Road. Easy and flat.
notes: Judgement call: assembled from named roads in OSM, not a published club route. City traffic after 7 AM.

n: Marina ride: Napier Bridge to Foreshore Estate
dist_source: OSRM road distance over OSM (router.project-osrm.org)
d: The full length of Kamarajar Salai along the Marina from Napier Bridge past the Lighthouse, then down Loop Road to Foreshore Estate.
notes: Safety: Kamarajar Salai is a main road; early morning only. Source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Marina_Beach

dist_source: OSRM road distance over OSM (router.project-osrm.org)
d: Chennai's two beaches linked: down the Marina and Santhome, across the Adyar at Thiru Vi Ka bridge and on to Elliot's Beach in Besant Nagar.
notes: Judgement call: route assembled from OSM roads between the two beaches; city traffic after 7 AM.

n: OMR ride: Madhya Kailash to Sholinganallur
dist_source: OSRM road distance over OSM (router.project-osrm.org)
d: Rajiv Gandhi Salai (OMR) south through the IT corridor from Madhya Kailash to Sholinganallur. Wide lanes, but only sensible at dawn.
notes: Safety: OMR carries heavy, fast traffic and metro works have dug up service lanes in places; riders report leisure cycling has dropped for this reason. Source: https://silverkris.singaporeair.com/cycling-chennai/ | https://citizenmatters.in/chennai-cycling-lane-mobility-bicycle-mayor/

n: Radial Road ride: Thoraipakkam to Pallavaram
dist_source: OSRM road distance over OSM (router.project-osrm.org)
d: The Thoraipakkam to Pallavaram Radial Road, crossing Pallikaranai marsh and passing Keelkattalai lake. Wide and straight, with marsh birds in winter.
notes: Judgement call: no club source names this as a route; included because it is the cycling approach to the marsh used in the SilverKris nature ride. Safety: heavy trucks and buses later in the day.
